assessment.title: CMC GAP ASSESSMENT

rows.observation: Drug X 100 mg immediate-release tablet is an illustrative case label. Strength and dosage form are assumptions, not verified product facts.
rows.gap: Actual product definition and composition not supplied.
rows.why: A case label cannot establish actual product composition.

rows.observation: COA: 98.6%; batch record: 99.1%. Same batch and method; difference is 0.5 percentage points.
rows.gap: No source supports choosing either result as the accepted value.
rows.why: Conflicting results cannot support an accepted batch-analysis statement.
rows.next: Request the original result and a qualified discrepancy assessment.

rows.observation: SYN-A water 0.3%, impurity 0.08%; SYN-B water 0.4%, impurity 0.09%.
rows.gap: These are synthetic analytical records, not commercial batch evidence.
rows.why: Values remain useful only with batch, method, unit and exact source attached.
rows.next: Verify against permitted real originals before professional use.

rows.observation: Raw 986 mg/g is retained alongside the recorded mass-basis conversion to 98.6%.
rows.gap: The conversion does not resolve the separate SYN-A conflict.
rows.why: A normalized value must not conceal the original unit or batch context.
rows.next: Confirm conversion basis and applicable specification with a professional.

rows.observation: No dissolution result is provided. It is an explicit required item in this synthetic exercise.
rows.gap: Result, procedure and acceptance criteria are absent.
rows.why: The missing critical value must remain missing, never guessed.
rows.next: Request the relevant permitted dissolution evidence.

rows.observation: Only synthetic method identifiers are supplied.
rows.gap: Full procedures and validation evidence are unavailable.
rows.why: A method identifier is not evidence of validated performance.
rows.next: Obtain procedures and validation records for qualified review.

rows.observation: No timepoints, storage conditions or stability results are supplied.
rows.gap: No shelf-life or storage claim is supported.
rows.why: Analytical fixture values cannot establish stability.
rows.next: Request an authorized stability data package.

assessment.decision: Request evidence; do not select an unsupported assay value or invent a missing result.
assessment.humanBoundary: Qualified CMC / RA / QA review remains required. Recorded example decisions are synthetic and are not professional sign-off.
assessment.nextProof: Resolve the discrepancy using supplied evidence, then recheck the changed revision before named human review.
